subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Planning and writing a narrative essay about an eating-out experience
outcomes: Plan a narrative essay with notes and share ideas with a group
Write a first draft with a title, introduction, body and conclusion

tf.s: A narrative essay should begin with an introduction that gives background and catches the reader's attention.
tf.why: A strong start makes the reader want to continue.

tf.s: Events in a narrative essay should be in order so the essay flows.
tf.why: A clear sequence makes the story easy to read.

tf.s: 'First, then, after that, finally' are linking words that show sequence.
tf.why: They show the order in which things happened.

tf.s: A narrative essay does not need a title.
tf.why: A suitable title is part of your essay.

tf.s: Sharing ideas with a group before writing gives you ideas and feedback.
tf.why: Others can ask questions that help you add details.

tf.s: The conclusion should come at the start of the essay.
tf.why: The conclusion comes at the end.

tf.s: The body paragraphs tell the main events of the story.
tf.why: The body is where the story happens.

tf.s: When you plan, you should write the final draft first and the notes later.
tf.why: Notes and planning come before any draft.

tf.s: 'A Nightmare Meal' would be a good title for an essay about a bad meal.
tf.why: The title shows the meal was terrible.

tf.s: You can only write a narrative essay about your best meal, never your worst.
tf.why: You can write about the best or the worst meal.

boxes.why: Background tells who, where and when.

mcq.q: What should a narrative essay have at the beginning?
o: An introduction that gives background and catches the reader's attention
mcq.why: A good opening sets the scene and interests the reader.
These words show the order of events.

mcq.q: Which list shows the parts of a narrative essay in the correct order?
mcq.why: Start with the title and end with the conclusion.

o: Your first full try at writing the essay
The final essay you hand in
mcq.why: You write the first draft after planning and improve it later.

mcq.q: Which is the best opening sentence for an essay about your best meal?
o: I have always loved eating out, but one meal was special.
After that, we paid the bill.
mcq.why: It introduces the topic and makes the reader curious.

mcq.q: Put these in order: (a) we paid and left (b) we arrived at the restaurant (c) we ordered our food.
mcq.why: Arrive, order, then pay and leave.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: '___, the waiter brought the wrong dish.' (the middle of the story)
mcq.why: 'Then' continues the sequence in the middle.

mcq.q: Why should events in a narrative essay be in order?
o: So the essay flows and is easy to read
So the teacher cannot follow it
mcq.why: A logical sequence helps the reader follow the story.

mcq.q: Why is it useful to tell your experience to a group before writing?
o: Their questions show which details to add
They will write the essay for you
It means you need no plan
mcq.why: Sharing gives ideas and feedback for a better essay.

mcq.q: A student's essay begins: 'Finally, we went home.' What is the problem?
o: 'Finally' shows the last event, so it belongs near the end
There is no problem at all
mcq.why: Sequence words must match the order of events.
